settings.title: NetsuCut settings
settings.defaultModelHint: The model a clip opens with. An already cut clip reopens with its own model.
settings.defaultPresetHint: Higher sensitivity catches more shot changes, but may add false positives.
settings.autoplayHint: Thumbnails play on their own when a clip opens. They stay muted.
settings.hoverVolumeHint: Volume of the hovered thumbnail. Autoplaying previews stay muted.
settings.playerVolumeHint: Shared by NetsuCut, Collections, Voice and Upscale. “—” = never set.
settings.densityHint: Target number of columns. The grid then adapts to the window width.
settings.playerOpenHint: When hidden, the grid takes the full width.
settings.rushSortHint: Display order in the Media Pool grid.
settings.exportProfileHint: Used by the Export button in the player panel.
settings.cardProfileHint: Used by the small button on each shot.

advanced.title: Settings · {{model}}
advanced.description: Each configuration keeps its own cached analysis.
advanced.minSceneFramesHint: No shot shorter than this. Cuts that would create one are dropped.
advanced.omniModeHint: What to cut on. “Clean cuts” ignores fades: they stay inside the shot.
advanced.overlapHint: Higher: long fades are spotted better, the analysis is slower.
advanced.intraLabelsHint: The app only cuts on the types you check. Fewer types checked, fewer shots.
advanced.interLabelsHint: Second filter, by role of the cut. Same rule: unchecked, no cut there.
advanced.intraDissolveHint: The two shots overlap, one replaces the other.
advanced.intraWipesHint: A shape sweeps across and reveals the next shot.
advanced.intraPushHint: The new shot pushes the old one out of frame.
advanced.intraSlideHint: The new shot slides over the old one.
advanced.intraZoomHint: A zoom or a spin carries you to the next shot.
advanced.intraDoorwayHint: Something passes in front of the lens and hides the cut.
advanced.interNewStartHint: First frame of the file, or a restart after black.
advanced.interHardCutHint: Clean cut between two shots. The common case.
advanced.interTransitionSourceHint: The last shot before the effect.
advanced.interTransitionHint: The frames of the effect itself.
advanced.interSuddenJumpHint: A stutter inside one shot, with no real shot change.

shared.modelHintTransnet: Fast, runs on the CPU. Finds hard cuts; the sensitivity you pick sets the threshold.
shared.modelHintOmni: Most reliable on dissolves, wipes and gradual transitions. Automatic, GPU.
shared.modelHintAutoShot: Good on fast edits and very dynamic footage. Threshold adjustable in advanced settings, GPU.
